parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value for this parameter on your client. Make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: EaisName
parameters.description: The name of the EAIS instance. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character, and cannot start with \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: EaisType
parameters.description:
The instance type of the EAIS instance. Valid values:

- eais.ei-a6.4xlarge

- eais.ei-a6.2xlarge

- eais.ei-a6.xlarge

- eais.ei-a6.large

parameters.name: Ecs
parameters.description: The parameters of the ECS instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region. Call the [DescribeRegions](~~364379~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the EAIS instance belongs.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the security group to which the instance belongs.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags of the instance. You can add up to 20 tags to an instance.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The key of the tag. Constraints:

- The key cannot be an empty string.

- The key can be up to 128 characters in length.

- The key cannot start with \`aliyun\` or \`acs:\`.

- The key cannot contain \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The value of the tag. Constraints:

- The value can be up to 128 characters in length.

- The value cannot start with \`aliyun\` or \`acs:\`.

- The value cannot contain \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description:
The ID of the vSwitch to which the instance belongs.

> The number of available IP addresses in the vSwitch determines the maximum number of EAIS instances that can be created in the vSwitch. Plan your CIDR block in advance.
